'''Havoc''' was an [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC]] [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commander]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Bred on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], he received constant military training with his brothers. Circa [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] he participated in a [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|battle]] fought on his homeworld, which cost him his life.

==Biography==
[[File:HavocGivesOrders-ARCT.png|thumb|left|220px|Havoc gives orders to Echo and Fives to take a sniper position while Kamino is under attack]]
{{Quote|Sir, you sent for us?''"<br />"''It's a dangerous assignment, but I want you two out on the bridge in sniper positions.''"<br />"''Yes, sir. We're on it.|Fives and Echo are ordered by Havoc to take up positions in Tipoca City|<ref name="arc" />}}
Havoc was bred on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and was one of the millions of clones of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. He and his brothers received constant military training in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] that followed his conception.<ref name="db" />

He was seen with [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Colt/Legends|Colt]] and [[Blitz/Legends|Blitz]] observing the [[Domino Squad/Legends|Domino Squad]] when they were training in the [[clone military education complex]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="SWArchive-''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Clone Cadets">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode301.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Clone Cadets}}</ref>

He was with a squad of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] when two [[Trident-class assault ship/Legends|trident drills]] appeared and dispatched [[Aqua droid/Legends|aqua droids]] commanded by [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], who ordered the machines to kill all the clones. The troopers immediately engaged Grievous's forces. While helping a wounded clone Havoc spotted [[99/Legends|99]] giving troopers extra DC-15 rifles, and he immediately ordered 99 out of the danger. But while distracted, Havoc was shot in the shoulder and, when 99 tried to help him, received a hit to the head moments later killing him instantly. 99 then grabbed Havoc's standard clone backpack that was full of grenades, and quickly hurried off to find Echo and Fives.<ref name="arc" />

==Equipment==
[[File:Havoc-CTRaF.png|thumb|right|220px|Commander Havoc wore experimental Phase II ARC trooper armor.]]
Havoc had blue markings on his experimental [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]] with a [[Rangefinder/Legends|rangefinder]] on the right side of his helmet. He wore a unique shoulder [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]] and had four blue squares that covered his chest and abdomen. He, [[Colt/Legends|Colt]], and [[Blitz/Legends|Blitz]] all wore the same specialized pauldron. Finally, he wore a [[Kama/Legends|kama]] with blue stripes. In combat, he wielded a [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]]. During the Battle of Kamino, he used a standard Republic backpack, which 99 used later.<ref name="arc" />
